card.name: Latias
card.condition: Very clean / mock graded from photos
card.notes: Mock grading review 2026-08-17: front centering measured 58/42 L-R and 46/54 T-B; back 47/53 L-R and 54/46 T-B. Corners/edges look very clean; angled surface photos show no obvious defects. PSA 9 is the clear photo-based favorite.
card.source: Existing exact-printing TCGplayer + PriceCharting research; new physical copy confirmed by updated Collection.pdf

grading.preGradeEstimate: PSA 9 most likely; PSA 8 downside; PSA 10 small upside
grading.decision: Grade candidate — wait for cheap PSA tier
grading.centering: PSA 9 — front measured 58/42 L-R and 46/54 T-B; back measured 47/53 L-R and 54/46 T-B
grading.corners: PSA 9 — corners appear sharp with no meaningful whitening/rounding visible
grading.edges: PSA 9 — edges look very clean with minimal visible whitening
grading.surface: PSA 9–10 — multiple angled-light photos show no obvious scratches, dents, impressions or notable holo scuffing
grading.manualVisualEstimate: PSA 9 clear favorite; PSA 10 limited mainly by front centering
grading.inspectionNotes: Pictured Latias 9/20 regular Dragon Vault holo, copy 3 of 3. Centering-app measurements: front 58/42 left-right and 46/54 top-bottom; back 47/53 left-right and 54/46 top-bottom. Front centering is outside a clean PSA-10 centering read but fits PSA-9 territory. Corners and edges appear very clean. Multiple unsleeved angled-light surface photos show no obvious scratch, dent, crease, impression or major holo scuff. Surface remains photo-based, but confidence is materially higher than with sleeved cards.
grading.estimatedGradedValue: PSA 9 is the expected outcome; PSA 10 is a small upside outcome
grading.gradedValueBasis: PSA recent exact-grade sales median used for PSA 9; PriceCharting fills unresolved grades.
grading.psaVerification: PSA direct median — PSA 9; PriceCharting fallback — 7/8/10
grading.psaVerificationNotes: Exact regular Dragon Vault Latias-Holo #9. PSA 9 latest five direct sales on PSA: $152.50, $65.00, $104.99, $79.99, $70.00 → median $79.99. PSA 8/10 do not have 3 sufficiently recent direct PSA sales located in the current pass, so the existing PriceCharting values remain fallbacks for those grades.
grading.psaDirectNotes: Graded-value hierarchy applied 2026-08-18: PSA recent exact-grade sales median when 3+ usable comps; otherwise PSA Estimate; otherwise PriceCharting fallback.
